messages:
Ana: Quick sync — prelaunch support path for MarketCo listing. Need final check on shared channel vs bridged war-room, oncall rotation, and fallback plan if partner incidents escalate to SEV-1 after hours.

Matt: For infra SEV, prefer a bridged shared channel + a dedicated bridge for 24/7 oncall. Shared channel alone complicates cross-org pings. Thoughts?

Clare: From success POV customers like MarketCo want a single shared channel for onboarding triage. We can keep shared channel + a `marketco-sev-ops` bridge alias that routes to eng-oncall during hours.

Liam: Proposed matrix:
```
Severity  Primary path         Backup path
P1        bridged #marketco     pager -> eng-oncall
P2        shared #marketco      email -> partner-liaison
P3        ticket -> triage      Slack thread
```
Also add runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketco-sev

Ana: Can ops create a dedicated bridged room and a short run-of-play doc? I can coordinate partner comms. cc @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: Created channel #marketco-bridge (shared) and scheduled 30m dry-run for 2024-12-01 17:00 UTC :rocket:

Matt: Suggest 15-min daily check-ins during launch week and an escalation play with handback at 1h mark to partner L2s. I'll draft the SLA snippets.

Clare: I'll own partner comms and runbook edits. Ana — can you update the contact sheet with oncall rotation and SRE pager links?

Ana: Yep adding now. I'll post final checklist in #partnerships by EOD.

Liam: +1 :thumbsup: Also recommend we add a fallback route to allow partner to open a phone bridge if Slack connectivity fails.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled dry-run tomorrow. React with :white_check_mark: if attending.
